sources.title: Five lessons from migrating to Postgres 17

sections.heading: Five lessons from migrating to Postgres 17
sections.text: We moved 40 services from MySQL to Postgres over six months. This post collects what we learned.

sections.heading: Plan the cutover
sections.text: Dual writes ran for 3 weeks before we switched reads. Replication lag stayed under 200 ms at the 99th percentile.

sections.heading: Measure everything
sections.text:
- Query latency dropped 27% after enabling parallel sequential scans.
- Storage grew 15% because of wider indexes.

sections.heading: Keep rollback cheap
sections.text:
A migration you cannot roll back is a bet, not a plan.

Every step had a documented rollback, and we used it twice.
